batch.topic: A traveller leaves a large suitcase at a staffed desk but carries a smaller bag; do not invent lockers or a fee.
A park reservation allows access to a garden but excludes a separately booked workshop; preserve the activity rather than turning it into a facility.
A guest asks whether late checkout can be requested for one room without applying it to the second room in the same booking.
A bus timetable distinguishes a route that runs on public holidays from one that runs only on weekdays; do not invent a country or a specific holiday.
